entries.subject: Hedman et al. Aegaeon measured axes
entries.finding: Hedman et al. (2020), Table 1 and Appendix B supply semiaxes 0.70 ± 0.05, 0.25 ± 0.06 and 0.20 ± 0.08 km. The selected analytic ellipsoid approximates those dimensions; it is not a detailed irregular mesh.

entries.subject: Cassini Aegaeon candidates N1643264167 (2010) and N1829223369 (2015)
entries.finding: Native OPUS products N1643264167 (2010) and N1829223369 (2015) were inspected. The published and OPUS longitude conventions disagree for the 2010 candidate, and camera/BPC reconstruction did not securely locate a usable disc; no image or colour patch was promoted.
entries.revisitWhen: A resolved frame with reconciled body-frame conventions and independently supportable registration can be retried.

entries.subject: PDS Saturn shape release for Aegaeon
entries.finding: The reviewed release did not provide a body-specific deliverable qualified for this package; the measured axes retain ownership of the approximation.
entries.revisitWhen: A released Aegaeon shape with usable frame and provenance can be reviewed.

entries.subject: Aegaeon terrain, colour and composition routes
entries.finding: Published photometry and spectra are integrated constraints, and no DEM, geology or mapped composition product was qualified.
entries.revisitWhen: A spatially registered image, spectral, terrain or geology product can support a lens.
